summary.text: Dave Heine is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 85 who has represented the district since 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is the owner of Heine Farms and a former vice president of Do It Best Corp.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Mark Wehrle, the Democratic nominee.

paragraphs.text: Heine graduated from New Haven High School in 1975 and earned a B.S. in accounting from Indiana University in 1979, and later attended Ohio State University's Executive Management Training.
He became the owner of Heine Farms and served as vice president and corporate officer for Do It Best Corp.

He has served on community boards, including as vice chairman of the Lutheran Foundation Board of Directors, as a board member of Big Brothers Big Sisters of Northeast Indiana and as chairman of the School Board of Central Lutheran School in New Haven.
He took office in the Indiana House on November 9, 2016, succeeding Casey Cox.
